description: Repository: Jidoka. Give memory capture a session, request, and capture-kind idempotency key or transactional outbox. Acceptance: recovery after a forced crash creates one memory record; a failed session commit creates no visible capture; memory remains supplemental to exact conversation state.

comments.text: Implemented in Jidoka commit d7094b26. Automatic conversation capture now uses a stable key from agent, session, request, and capture kind. Memory stores collapse repeated keys, and JidoMemory uses the key as its provider record id. New-turn, resume, and recovery capture only after the completed session persists. Tests force a commit failure with no visible memory and kill a worker after a durable tool result; recovery commits the exact conversation and creates one record without repeating the tool. Validation: 663 passed, 38 excluded; focused parity 4 passed; mix quality passed.

title: Make memory capture idempotent and commit-ordered
